rule.statement: The owner of land or a moveable may approach court for a declaration of rights if a person who apparently has no rights asserts a servitude over the land or movable.
rule.supporting_quote: The owner of land or a moveable may approach court for a declaration of rights, if a person who apparently has no rights asserts a servitude over the land or movable, or if the holder of a servitude acts in excess of his or her rights.
